style: Avant-garde art-punk with trashy spectacle and panic-under-function pressure. Harmony: Sl ndro-informed five-step pitch field with bitonal modal drone, microtonal beating, and polyharmonic suspension fields. Melody: Angular cabaret patter with Akan-influenced lexical tone contours, glottalized vowel leaps, and hocketed counterpoint. Rhythm: Competing entrainment clocks, 3:2 coupling, asymmetric motorik pulse, and double-time hallucination. Timbre: Fluorescent ballast hum, shift-register noise, magnetic tape loops, 8-bit pulse synth, Cristal Baschet, thunder sheets, large sheet metal, and spring reverb tanks. Performance: Deadpan trashy panic played straight with communal infection and perpetual upward kinetic drive. Production: Dry close-miked body percussion with local crunch, sharp silence cuts, and raw unwashed separation across all discrete channels.
